objective: Converge current TPI-JEPA code toward a Q(s,a)-centric planner while preserving comparability to existing baselines.

phase_1: Expose q_pred through predict_from_latent and planner rows.
Allow oracle ranking/value training to use q_pred.
phase_2: Run parallel Q oracle training sweep.
Evaluate expanded oracle val, transfer oracle, hard-fault gate, and 8-circuit planner gate.
excluded_initially: Do not delete legacy heads in the first implementation.
Do not change default planner score until q_pred passes gates.
Do not remove SCOAP input features.

guardrails: checkpoint remains loadable with legacy evaluation scripts

parallel_policy: Run independent sweeps and gates in parallel across cuda:4,cuda:5,cuda:6,cuda:7 unless there is a dependency or shared-output collision.
